hero.title: Mobile apps your users actually adopt.

overview.title: Product-led mobile engineering for business outcomes.
overview.description: Enterprise mobile projects fail when they try to replicate every desktop feature on a small screen or launch without understanding how users actually work. Forgeone takes a workflow-first approach: we identify the high-value tasks mobile makes better, then build focused experiences with polish — fast load times, intuitive navigation, reliable sync, and security built in from day one. The result is apps that earn adoption, not shelfware status.

items.question: Should we build native or cross-platform?
items.answer: For most business applications, React Native or Flutter delivers native-quality performance with a single codebase and faster delivery. We recommend native Swift/Kotlin only when you need platform-specific capabilities like advanced AR, complex background processing, or maximum performance on older devices.

items.question: How long does a typical mobile app take to build?
items.answer: A focused MVP with core workflows typically takes 12–16 weeks. Enterprise apps with offline sync, compliance requirements, and backend integration may take 20–28 weeks. We deliver incrementally so you can pilot with real users early.

items.question: Can you build apps that work offline?
items.answer: Yes — offline-first architecture is a core capability. We design local data stores, conflict resolution strategies, and background sync engines so your app remains fully functional without connectivity.

items.question: Do you handle App Store submission?
items.answer: We manage the full submission process for both Apple App Store and Google Play, including metadata optimization, screenshot design guidance, and navigating review requirements — including enterprise compliance documentation.

items.question: What about ongoing maintenance after launch?
items.answer: We offer post-launch support packages covering OS updates, bug fixes, performance monitoring, and feature iteration. We also document thoroughly so your internal team can take over maintenance when ready.
